sensing.gate: real-robot fixed-rate scan gate per section (Sim2Real real_eval_fixed.py _on_raw_scan), AdaptiveSensing/evaluation/section_scan_gate.py

sections.column_order: column 0 = leftmost (largest azimuth); sections left to right
sections.fse: full-scan equivalents = rays acquired (reset scan included) / total_rays = sum_s w_s n_s

sensing.rule: every new native scan: section s accepts it if t >= next_sample_time[s] (its columns of the held image <- the scan), then next_sample_time[s] += period[s] until > t; reset scan accepted by every section, next_sample_time[s] = t0 + period[s]
sensing.policy_input: {'policy': current env navigation features, 'lidar': composite held image}
